verdict.rationale: Adyen documents terminal and transaction management from a unified Customer Area, ordering terminals for delivery to a chosen location, an account hierarchy of company account, merchant accounts and stores, and per-merchant-account payout settings. These establish multi-location structure and fleet management, but per-location device assignment, settings and reporting are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-store device assignment, per-location terminal settings configuration, per-location reporting/analytics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting
